exposure: timing of urinary catheter removal post-cesarean section (12 hours vs. >=24 hours)
outcome: post-cesarean section urinary complaints (dysuria, urinary frequency, urgency, burning micturition)
cohort: Women undergoing elective primary cesarean section.
finding: Urinary catheter removal 12 hours post-cesarean section was associated with decreased post-operative urinary complaints, shorter time to first void, faster ambulation, and shorter hospital stays compared to removal at 24 hours.
